Subject: Short-term credit need for 72h high-qps soak

Hi Ben —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We validated the model behavior on small samples and need to run a 72-hour soak to validate latency and p95 under sustained peak QPS (target is ~7k requests/min, typical prompt length ~220 tokens).

Can Redwood provision a temporary credit pool for the run? Rough numbers: ~120k–160k token-equivalent credits depending on batching; wedll aim for 150k as a safe estimate. We expect to start the soak on Thursday, Nov 18, 02:00 UTC and run for 72 hours.

Wedve attached our short test plan and current load script (peregrine-test-plan.pdf). Procurement is looped for any paperwork. If you need a signed addendum or a promo code, let us know.

Key asks:
- 150k trial credits unlocked for 72-hour window (start/stop timestamps configurable)
- Tags on usage so we can separate POC traffic in the dashboard

Appreciate the help — this soak is the gating factor for our procurement decision.

Best,
Sam
Sam Henley
SRE & Platform Lead, Peregrine Analytics
[Attachment: peregrine-test-plan.pdf (application/pdf)]

Thanks Sam — got it. Appreciate the test plan and the timeline.

Quick thoughts:
- Can you confirm the lead "project tag" you want us to apply for the POC (so usage is filtered in the console)?
- Do you have a HubSpot deal id or PO reference we should tie this to?

My tentative proposal while approvals happen: provision an initial 50k credits immediately so your engineers can smoke the scripts and well extend to the full amount once sign-off is in place. If you need the full 150k upfront, flag that and well fast-track.

We can approve a temporary top-up for this POC. Terms below:
